content.raw:
Hard Money For Real Estate

If you have a real estate project that is in need of financing, partner with Flatiron Realty Capital. We’re a private lending company offering developers, investors and brokers funding for real estate investments. Whether you’re flipping an old home or purchasing land for a brand-new development, Flatiron Realty Capital can help with your financing needs every step of the way.

As your real estate private lenders, we have exclusive solutions that can satisfy your short-term and long-term financing needs. We’re the fastest-closing private lenders for real estate investors in the country, helping you avoid lengthy and complicated processes with banks. Our private real estate loans have helped countless projects succeed, and we can do the same for you.

To learn more about what makes us the leading private real estate lenders serving the industry, get in touch with one of our representatives to get your rate today. Brokers and agents can maximize their earning potential by following the links to learn about becoming one of our partners.

Your Partner In Private Lending

Competitive Rates

We work hard to get you the best rate possible. Because we are a direct private lender, we provide competitive rates directly to borrowers.

Personalized Service

Knowledgeable in-house experts help you every step of the way. An experienced account manager is there whenever you need them.

Fast Closings

Let us know the best way to get in touch. We'll reach out as soon as possible to get you our best rates. We pride ourselves on fast closing and same-day commitments, often helping our customers close within 5 days*.

Visit for more details
